=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:957-1075 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: In `--ref` mode, `_resolve_base_deletion_history_ref` / `_base_deletion_superseding_commit` treat the integration-branch history (the wave-dispatch caller passes the integration ref at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:36433-36435) as proof of a base-branch deletion, so a non-resolver integration-side deletion of a `must_contain` file after capture emits FINGERPRINT_BASE_DELETION_SUPERSEDED_V1 and marks the fingerprint satisfied while the default branch still has the file.
  WHY: The wave gate can fail open on lost intent, and no test covers this path (test_base_deletion_supersede_in_ref_mode_after_resolver_merge always has main delete the file). Reviewers disagree on severity: gemini, minimax and luna rate it MAJOR (confidence 4), while sonnet rates it NIT (confidence 2) as a naming and documentation mismatch that matches the existing evolution-defense trust model. The highest rating (MAJOR, mapped to high) is used. glm's narration also argues the finding fails validation under the gate's documented contract (tests/test_verify_integration_fingerprints_post_capture_evolution.py:1-27).
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:527 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `review / gate` check run (head 456c3e08) failed with exit code 75 when `support_main_json="$(gh_api_retry repos/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/branches/main)"` gave up on HTTP 403 (`GH_API_RETRY outcome=gave_up kind=primary bucket=core status=403`).
  WHY: The review gate did not complete. All reviewers agree no hunk in this PR caused it (it is a rate limit or infrastructure failure). Reviewers disagree on severity: luna rates it BLOCKER (confidence 5), sonnet and glm rate it NIT (confidence 3), and gemini gives no rating. The highest rating (BLOCKER, mapped to critical) is used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:_resolve_base_deletion_history_ref, lines 971-974 (in ref mode the history is the verified `--ref` itself), used by _base_deletion_superseding_commit through `git log --no-renames --diff-filter=D --max-count=1 <history_sha> -- <path>`. The wave-dispatch caller passes the integration-branch SHA (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:36433-36435). | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: In ref mode the base-deletion search walks the whole integration-branch history, so any non-merge commit without the `[ai-merge-resolve]` prefix that deleted the path after capture passes, including a later sub-issue squash-merge. The marker reason `must_contain_file_deleted_on_base_after_capture...` and the fragments still call it a base-branch deletion.
  WHY: An integration-only non-resolver deletion is logged as FINGERPRINT_BASE_DELETION_SUPERSEDED_V1 and counted as satisfied. This matches the existing evolution-defense trust model and is not a resolver bypass, but the defense is wider than its name, marker and documentation say. A one-line docstring or agents.d note would fix the mismatch.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:line 527, `support_main_json="$(gh_api_retry repos/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/branches/main)"` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The "review / gate" check (head 456c3e08) failed here with `GH_API_RETRY outcome=gave_up kind=primary bucket=core status=403 ... wait_secs=730`, then exit code 75, after taking the promote-candidate path and falling through to the protected-main lookup.
  WHY: This is a transient primary rate limit on the shared token, not caused by any hunk in this PR (review_autofix.yml is not changed). Re-running after the limit resets should clear it, and no code change is needed.

Neither .github/workflows/pr-checks.yml nor tests/test_pr_checks_workflow.py exists in the checkout. .github/workflows/lint-pr-body-auto-close.yml has pr-body-lint pinned at lines 52-53, so the base lacks main's #9698 move and the pin is not delivered on the default branch. Because the verifier is staged from main (§8), it only clears the #9421 block once it reaches the default branch.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The red-on-base acceptance done-checks for tests/test_verify_integration_fingerprints_post_capture_evolution.py::test_base_deletion_supersedes_missing_must_contain_in_merge_working_tree and ::test_base_deletion_supersede_in_compare_against_baseline_mode.
  Expected change site: tests/test_verify_integration_fingerprints_post_capture_evolution.py, the base-deletion section (from about line 366).
  Evidence of absence: The Acceptance table marks both "unmet (passes on base)". A static reading says both should fail on base (the pre-PR _evaluate_fp_state branch at lines 1633-1644 returns rc=1), so this is likely a harness artifact, but the done-check has no evidence that it is met.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- HARDENING: scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py, _resolve_base_deletion_history_ref ref-mode branch (lines 971-974) and docstring. The `base_ref=<ref>` label and the "deleted_on_base" reason overstate what was checked. Suggested fix: add a docstring line stating the ref-mode trust model, and optionally emit `base_ref=ref:<sha12>`. Estimated 2-3 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
